Persian comma ، semicolon ؛ question mark ؟; quotation marks « » for quoted names; keep the ellipsis … of menu items that open a dialog.
Persian ی and ک (never ي ك); ZWNJ (نیم‌فاصله) in می‌، ‌ها، ‌های، ‌ای and compounds (پیش‌نمایش); ezafe after silent ه written هٔ (اندازهٔ پیکسل).

The paragraph direction follows the first strong letter: start a text with a Persian word rather than a Latin one (eov, GPU, H&E, TIFF, [shortcuts]), e.g. برنامهٔ eov راه‌اندازی نشد. Placeholders that eov isolates do not count.
Persian uses the singular noun after a number, so both plural forms are usually the same; both must show {n} (form 0 is used for 0 and 1).
